about: The control clock: a daily series at 01:00 UTC (at 00:00 UTC, since the probe of 2026-11-13, the undone notes leave a record where the two forms meet and the switch is refused on Google, 3.48 and 3.65, which is not this case's subject), a day given its own notes and the change undone, the series made all-day, then the redo. Since the gate (decisions.md, "An undo acts on a day only where the journal says exactly where it is") the redo is refused as not_undoable, with nothing written here or sent: the day had no row and no skip when the series was re-placed, so nothing recorded where it went, and it is never placed by its key or its date (x-day). It is refused all the same, as at every clock.
